answer: Proposal: each key streams a distinct nonce-encrypted marble dataset at 1 Gbps for 20 seconds to two independent receivers in one shared window. Receivers sign quill receipts with sampled block hashes; validators check both receipts against a ridge throughput threshold and deny that key’s epoch pay if either stream is missing or replayed. A farm can rent a larger link and share its encoder, but k clones need k simultaneous distinct streams to each receiver; borrowing capacity still reserves extra egress per clone. This is a proposed rule, not MinePoA policy.
